text:
```yaml
name: govulncheck

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  govulncheck:
    name: govulncheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5.3.0
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@v1.1.0
```
